spans.s: + बन्ध सेतु- + बन्ध, m. 1. a dike,
. the ridge of rocks between the Coromandel coast and Ceylon.

सेतु, i. e. सि + तु, m.
 1. A mound, a bank, a dike,
; figurat. Means of protecting (the law and institutes), Bhāg.

; 3, 21, 54.
 2. A high causeway in fields.
 3. A landmark,

. A pass, a defile.
 5. Figurat. Law, Bhāg.

. A bridge, Pañc. i. d. 115 (cf. my transl.).
 7. The islands between India and Ceylon (cf. नल-सेतु),
सेत्र, i. e. सि + त्र, n. A ligament or fetter.
